# Keep the Light 1.43.1

- **Fixed: Tidy up originals found nothing** when the converted copy had a different name from the original (for example a Plex-style name). It now also pairs files by what is in them: the file Keep the Light converted and the one other video in the folder with the same length, whatever their names. When it can't be sure which file is the original, it leaves both alone and says so.
